brandPositioningSummary: Courtyard by Marriott is a Marriott select-service brand oriented to business and bleisure demand within Marriott International. For owners, the affiliation case is business demand capture, select-service operations, renovation or conversion diligence, and Marriott Bonvoy platform participation. It should be evaluated on its own guest promise and operating implications, not as a generic parent-brand substitute or an interchangeable peer among AC Hotels by Marriott, Moxy Hotels, City Express by Marriott, Fairfield by Marriott.
ownerFitSummary: business demand capture, select-service operations, renovation or conversion diligence, and Marriott Bonvoy platform participation
propertyFitSummary: urban, suburban, and airport select-service hotels with meeting-light public space and consistent business transient demand

scenarios.title: Business select-service conversion
scenarios.summary: A hotel competing for midweek business demand that needs Marriott distribution and a clear select-service prototype. Courtyard fits when public space, rooms, and F&B can support business transient expectations without drifting into lifestyle-select positioning. Owners should diligence whether Courtyard by Marriott is a better fit than AC Hotels by Marriott for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.

scenarios.title: Airport or edge-city new-build
scenarios.summary: A new-build near airports or corporate nodes where guests want reliable select-service product. Diligence should confirm prototype, Bistro/public-space obligations, and Bonvoy systems sequencing. Owners should diligence whether Courtyard by Marriott is a better fit than AC Hotels by Marriott for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.

scenarios.title: CALA business corridor example
scenarios.summary: CALA references such as Courtyard Cancun Airport help owners evaluate Marriott select-service participation in regional business and airport demand sets. Keep the property matched by name and labeled CALA. Owners should diligence whether Courtyard by Marriott is a better fit than AC Hotels by Marriott for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.
